messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency breach detected on continuous-batching path (us-west-2). p99 crossed SLO (was 300ms, now 1.8s). Streaming stalls and increased queue depth observed. Dashboard: https://redwood.example/d/contbatch/p99?org=1

Dave Oncall: I'm on it — grabbing traces and recent deploys. anyone oncall for infra?

Chloe ML-Infra: I see the same in traces: large tail from 'wait_for_batch' times. KV miss rate up ~3x, and many requests are getting batched with very long sequences. suspect mixed-seqlen padding amplification.

Ben Platform: Any customer-facing 5xx/errors? CS?

Erin CS: AcmeCorp reported intermittent timeouts around 09:12 PST, they saw 504s. CS collecting headers and request ids. I'll post them here when available.

Dave Oncall: ok logs show scheduler queue depth spiking at 09:10-09:14. streaming requests are getting pulled into large batches because max_batch_size didn't limit fast enough.

Sam Eng: Do we have seqlen histogram for the window? Could be a bimodal distribution creating huge effective batch compute.

Chloe ML-Infra: yes — histogram attached (summarized): short -> 60% at 16-32 tokens, long -> 25% at 800-1200 tokens, rest mid. Continuous batching currently aggregates by time window only; long requests inflate compute time for whole batch.

Dave Oncall: immediate mitigations proposed (quick list):
- reduce max_batch_size to 16 for contbatch pools
- enable seqlen-aware routing (fast-path for short seqs)
- enable batching preemption for streaming paths
- if needed, divert high-seqlen traffic to dedicated pool

Ben Platform: reducing max_batch will impact throughput but should knock down p99 quickly. +1 for doing that as a live mitigation.

Chloe ML-Infra: I can apply the change. CLI for change: 
```
# reduce batch size and enable fairshare preemption
rwictl pool update contbatch-usw2 --max-batch-size=16 --enable-fairshare=true --enable-preempt=true
```

Dave Oncall: running it now.

Deploy Bot: Deploy started by Dave Oncall: job/contbatch-adjust-230123 in us-west-2.

Dave Oncall: deployed. Confirmed config committed.

incident-bot: MITIGATION APPLIED: contbatch pool config updated. Automated checks running.

Chloe ML-Infra: early metrics: p99 dropped from ~1.8s -> ~420ms within 3 minutes. p95 stayed ~110ms. GPU utilization rose slightly but still within threshold.

Erin CS: AcmeCorp confirms fewer timeouts; they still saw 1 spike but much improved. I've escalated to account team and told them we're mitigating.

Sam Eng: good short-term. For long-term we should do:
- implement length-based binning in scheduler (so short vs long don't mix)
- KV cache affinity for streaming to avoid evictions when long seqs run
- smarter batch size auto-tuner per workload

Chloe ML-Infra: Agreed. I'm going to open an RFC and a pair of tickets: one for scheduler binning and one for KV cache sticky routing. I'll prioritize the scheduler change.

Ben Platform: also recommend creating a canary route for high-seqlen requests to a separate dedicated pool (lower concurrency). snippet: 
```
# create routing rule to route if seq_len > 512 to dedicated-highseq pool
rwictl route add --expr 'seq_len > 512' --pool dedicated-highseq-usw2 --weight 100
```

Dave Oncall: leaving oncall in 10m. handing off to Chloe for post-mortem and follow-ups. tagging @Chloe ML-Infra. :hand: 

Chloe ML-Infra: taking over. I've created tickets: INC-4567 (live mitigation notes), ENG-7890 (scheduler binning RFC). Notes in the ticket: 
- root cause: mixed sequence length distribution + time-window batching + insufficient preemption/fairshare
- mitigation: reduced max_batch_size, enabled preemption/fairshare, suggested canary route for high-seq
- customer impact: AcmeCorp ~20% of their requests hit timeouts during spike window

Erin CS: I'm drafting a customer note for AcmeCorp and will send to Dave/Chloe for review.

Ben Platform: monitoring set: alert if p99 > 500ms for >5m, and GPU util > 85% for 10m. Keep an eye for throughput regressions.

Dave Oncall: quick perf numbers pre/post: 
```
# before (09:09-09:14)
p95=110ms p99=1800ms throughput=1200 qps
# after (09:17-09:22)
p95=115ms p99=420ms throughput=1050 qps
```

Chloe ML-Infra: I'll run a canary for the binning patch in staging tomorrow and schedule a deploy to canary cluster.

Deploy Bot: Recorded incident handoff: user=Dave Oncall -> user=Chloe ML-Infra, notes="reduced max_batch_size, enabled preempt/fairshare, tickets INC-4567/ENG-7890"

Dave Oncall: Thanks team. I'm OOO now. :thumbsup:

Chloe ML-Infra: Thanks — will follow up. Marking this thread resolved for live mitigation; keeping tickets open for the engineering fixes. :eyes:
